# Rulings for fix pass 1 (orchestrator, 2026-10-27)

## Owner decision: AV1 rate becomes capped constant quality
Asked after the `--rate` run measured SVT-AV1 VBR at 0.667–0.670 of target, against CX-9's expected 14–22 % undershoot. The owner chose **"Capped constant quality"** (CRF with the requested bitrate as a ceiling):
- AV1 encodes at a constant quality chosen to MATCH OR BEAT HEVC's quality at HEVC's own rate;
- the requested rate is the cap: `video_bitrate`, or the Quality popup's tier rate with the 0.07 bpp default (CX-9);
- simple scenes come out smaller, and file size is not fixed in advance.

What to do:
- Record a new §11 entry (CX-13) amending CX-9 for the AV1 rows, BEFORE the code, with:
  - the CRF value per speed (or one value) and how it was chosen;
  - how Quality tiers and `video_bitrate` map to the cap;
  - whether a Quality tier also moves the CRF.
- Calibrate the CRF from the spike's VMAF data (`designs/codec-export.md` "S", `tools/proof/work/codec-spike/`). If those data can't place it, measure it: on the spike's 1080p clips, AV1 at each speed must reach VMAF ≥ HEVC's at HEVC's default rate.
- SVT-AV1 v4.2.0 supports capped CRF (CRF rate-control mode plus a maximum bit rate). Verify this against its own documentation and headers in `build/codecs/include`.
- Replace the `--rate` rows: the file stays at or under the cap (state the tolerance), and quality is VMAF ≥ HEVC's on the measured clip. Use ffmpeg's libvmaf if present, as the spike did; otherwise score SSIM against HEVC and say so.
- Update the guide's Quality sentence for AV1, the sheet's text if it names the rate, and the MCP `export` description if it says how `video_bitrate` applies to av1.
- STOP only if the ruling genuinely can't be met. For example: no CRF reaches HEVC's VMAF under the cap. Then state the numbers and the options.

## Review findings
Fix all three should-fixes per 05-review.md's recommended order.

**`all-sync`:**
- Run the inverse mutant (`sync: false`) against A5.
- If it is caught, keep the code and make that the mutant.
- If not, remove the attachment as unobservable and reword CX-12 (3).

**`open-gop`:**
- Make A5 fail on any hidden KEY_FRAME, then re-run the mutant.
- If it still survives, retire it as equivalent. Record the frame_type/show_frame sequence comparison in CX-12 (3) and the C1 record. Keep the line.

**`ReelCore.swift`:**
- First, a pure move of `ReelAV1.Color` and `ReelAV1.Config` (with its hex decoder) into a values file (`CoreValues.swift` or similar), gated alone.
- Then a second pure move of non-`rc_*` code, so the file ends at or below 789.

**Nits:** fix all of them:
- the record figures;
- CX-9 (4)'s result, now superseded by CX-13; record the measured VBR band there;
- the Speed popup remembering the speed across formats;
- the header comment at `framejob_core.h:815`.

Do not file the undershoot issue: the owner has decided it.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Codec spike #377: run one encode, time it, measure its quality.

run.py <clip> <encoder> <preset> [--bits 8|10] [--kbps N] [--rep R] [--novmaf]
Appends one JSON line to results.jsonl and prints it.
"""
import argparse, json, os, re, subprocess, time

S = "/Users/kevingalligan/devel/framejob-codecs/tools/proof/work/codec-spike"
AOMENC = f"{S}/build/aom/aomenc"
SVT = f"{S}/src/svt-av1/Bin/Release/SvtAv1EncApp"
VPXENC = f"{S}/build/libvpx/vpxenc"
FRAMES = 150


def cmd(enc, preset, src, out, bits, kbps, fps):
    kf = str(round(2 * fps))  # Frame Job's 2 s max keyframe interval
    if enc == "aom":  # preset "good-N" or "rt-N"
        mode, n = preset.split("-")
        tiles = n.endswith("t")  # "good-6t": 4 tiles (2 columns, 2 rows) instead of 2 columns
        n = n.rstrip("t")
        c = [AOMENC, f"--{mode}", f"--cpu-used={n}", "--passes=1", "--end-usage=vbr",
             f"--target-bitrate={kbps}", f"--kf-max-dist={kf}", "--threads=12", "--row-mt=1",
             "--tile-columns=1", "--ivf", "-o", out]
        if tiles:
            c += ["--tile-rows=1"]
        c.append("--lag-in-frames=35" if mode == "good" else "--lag-in-frames=0")
        if bits == 10:
            c += ["--bit-depth=10", "--input-bit-depth=10"]
        return c + [src]
    if enc == "svt":
        return [SVT, "-i", src, "-b", out, "--preset", preset, "--rc", "1", "--tbr", str(kbps),
                "--keyint", kf, "--passes", "1", "--progress", "0"]
    if enc == "vpx":  # "good-N" or "rt-N"
        mode, n = preset.split("-")
        c = [VPXENC, "--codec=vp9", f"--{mode}", f"--cpu-used={n}", "--passes=1",
             "--end-usage=vbr", f"--target-bitrate={kbps}", f"--kf-max-dist={kf}",
             "--threads=12", "--row-mt=1", "--tile-columns=2", "--frame-parallel=0", "--ivf",
             "-o", out]
        c += ["--lag-in-frames=25", "--auto-alt-ref=1"] if mode == "good" else ["--lag-in-frames=0"]
        if bits == 10:
            c += ["--profile=2", "--bit-depth=10", "--input-bit-depth=10"]
        return c + [src]
    if enc == "hevc":  # VideoToolbox, as Frame Job's hevc / hevc_10bit rows ask it
        return ["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-y", "-i", src, "-c:v",
                "hevc_videotoolbox", "-b:v", f"{kbps}k", "-g", kf, "-profile:v",
                "main10" if bits == 10 else "main", "-tag:v", "hvc1", out]
    raise SystemExit(f"unknown encoder {enc}")


def timed(c):
    load = os.getloadavg()[0]
    t0 = time.time()
    p = subprocess.run(["/usr/bin/time", "-l"] + c, capture_output=True, text=True)
    wall = time.time() - t0
    if p.returncode != 0:
        raise SystemExit(f"FAILED {' '.join(c)}\n{p.stderr[-3000:]}")
    err = p.stderr
    user = float(re.search(r"([\d.]+) user", err).group(1))
    sys_ = float(re.search(r"([\d.]+) sys", err).group(1))
    rss = int(re.search(r"(\d+)\s+maximum resident set size", err).group(1))
    return wall, user + sys_, rss, load


def vmaf(dist, ref, bits, tag):
    log = f"{S}/out/{tag}.vmaf.json"
    pix = "yuv420p10le" if bits == 10 else "yuv420p"
    lavfi = (f"[0:v]format={pix},setpts=PTS-STARTPTS[d];[1:v]format={pix},setpts=PTS-STARTPTS[r];"
             f"[d][r]libvmaf=log_fmt=json:log_path={log}:n_threads=12:"
             "feature=name=psnr|name=float_ssim")
    subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-i", dist, "-i", ref,
                    "-lavfi", lavfi, "-f", "null", "-"], check=True)
    pooled = json.load(open(log))["pooled_metrics"]
    return {k: round(pooled[k]["mean"], 3) for k in
            ("vmaf", "psnr_y", "float_ssim") if k in pooled} | {
        "vmaf_min": round(pooled["vmaf"]["min"], 2)}


def main():
    a = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    a.add_argument("clip"); a.add_argument("enc"); a.add_argument("preset")
    a.add_argument("--bits", type=int, default=8)
    a.add_argument("--kbps", type=int, default=4354)  # 1920*1080*30*0.07 (hevc default)
    a.add_argument("--rep", type=int, default=1)
    a.add_argument("--novmaf", action="store_true")
    o = a.parse_args()
    src = f"{S}/media/{o.clip}.y4m"
    fps = 25 if o.clip.startswith("gh5") else 30
    kbps = o.kbps if fps == 30 else round(o.kbps * 25 / 30)
    tag = f"{o.clip}-{o.enc}-{o.preset}-{o.bits}b-{kbps}k-r{o.rep}"
    out = f"{S}/out/{tag}." + ("mp4" if o.enc == "hevc" else "ivf")
    c = cmd(o.enc, o.preset, src, out, o.bits, kbps, fps)
    wall, cpu, rss, load = timed(c)
    size = os.path.getsize(out)
    r = {"clip": o.clip, "enc": o.enc, "preset": o.preset, "bits": o.bits, "rep": o.rep,
         "target_kbps": kbps, "fps_enc": round(FRAMES / wall, 2), "wall_s": round(wall, 2),
         "cpu_s_per_frame": round(cpu / FRAMES, 3), "max_rss_mb": round(rss / 2**20),
         "load1_before": round(load, 1),
         "actual_kbps": round(size * 8 / (FRAMES / fps) / 1000), "cmd": " ".join(c)}
    if not o.novmaf:
        r |= vmaf(out, src, o.bits, tag)
    with open(f"{S}/results.jsonl", "a") as f:
        f.write(json.dumps(r) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in r.items() if k != "cmd"}))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

2	"""Road map "codec-export" C1 — the `av1` row: AV1 in MP4 through the bundled
3	SVT-AV1 (spec §11 CX-1, CX-2, CX-9, CX-10, CX-12).
4	
5	    python3 tools/proof/av1_export_proof.py [--app debug|release|PATH] [--rate]
6	    python3 tools/proof/av1_export_proof.py --mutant NAME
7	
8	Launches its own instances of the chosen app (`proof_app.py`: `--app`, else
9	`RC_PROOF_APP`, else Debug; a build older than its inputs is refused) on scratch
10	sockets, works under `tools/proof/work/av1-export/`, closes every project it opens
11	with `discard: true` and stops each instance by its own PID. ffprobe and ffmpeg
12	(Homebrew, with libdav1d) only READ the files: this Mac has no AV1 decoder, so
13	nothing here imports or plays an AV1 file through Frame Job or AVFoundation.
14	
15	Rows (`<ID> ok|FAIL — <detail>`, then `scores: n/m`; exit 0 iff all passed):
16	
17	* Z1 — every instance's log is silent: no `Frame Job: ` line (the parity check),
18	  no `Svt[` line (SVT's own banner, which CX-12 (6) routes away) and no
19	  `SVT-AV1: ` line (a warning or error it passed on).
20	* A1 — `export {preset: av1}` of AV.mov (640 × 360, 30 fps, 5 s) under a text
21	  clip is done; ffprobe reads video `av1` / `av01` / Main / `yuv420p` /
22	  640 × 360 and audio `aac` / `mp4a`, and the video lasts 5.0 s ± one frame.
23	* A2 — the file's compatible brands include `av01`.
24	* A3a — the bitstream: `-bsf:v trace_headers`' every sequence header has
25	  `color_description_present_flag` 1, `color_primaries`, `transfer_characteristics`
26	  and `matrix_coefficients` 1/1/1 and `color_range` 0.
27	* A3b — the container: the `av01` sample entry's `colr` box, read from the MP4's
28	  own bytes (moov/trak/mdia/minf/stbl/stsd), is `nclx` 1/1/1 with full_range 0.
29	* A4 — `ffmpeg -v error` decodes the file with no error line, ffprobe's decoded
30	  frame count is the range's (150), and `trace_headers` shows no temporal
31	  delimiter OBU (type 2).
32	* A5 — A1's file: the first packet is a keyframe (K), the longest K-to-K gap is
33	  ≤ 2.0 s, the key count is ≤ ceil(duration / 2 s) + 1 with at least one packet
34	  that is not K, and through `trace_headers` every K packet's shown frame is a
35	  KEY_FRAME (`frame_type` 0 with `show_frame` 1) and no other packet's is.
36	* A6 — a 1920 × 1080, 30 fps, 120 s project (AV.mov 24 times, filling the
37	  canvas) exported at Balanced, cancelled once its progress is above 0 while it
38	  encodes — after the loudness measurement's phase, whose progress is the bar's
39	  first share, so the cancel meets the encoder and not the measurement: the
40	  status reads `cancelled` within 10 s of `cancel_export`, and no file is at
41	  the path. (Uncancelled, its 3,600 frames take far longer than 10 s at
42	  SVT-AV1's ~41–148 fps at 1080p, `designs/codec-export.md`'s spike.)
43	* A7 — A1's project at each `encoder_speed` (faster, balanced, smaller): each
44	  done, its answer's `encoder_speed` the one asked, and the three files' sizes
45	  pairwise different; `encoder_speed: "fast"` and `encoder_speed` on `h264`
46	  are each refused naming `encoder_speed`, and nothing is at either path.
47	* A8 — `size: [640, 480]` on the 640 × 360 canvas is 640 × 480 with the
48	  picture letterboxed (the top 56 rows' luma ≤ 20, the middle rows' mean above
49	  20, frame 0's Y plane); `size: "720p"` decodes at 1280 × 720.
50	* A9 — an in/out export of 1 s to 3 s holds 60 frames.
51	* S1 — an instance pinned with `screens.py`'s PINS, `-RCDevAppearance light`
52	  and `FrameJobExportChoice` `{"preset_id":"av1","encoder_speed":"smaller"}`:
53	  File ▸ Export… shows Format "AV1 (MP4)", the popup after "Speed:" reads
54	  "Smaller file" and is drawn enabled, and the footnote is
55	  "AV1 · MP4 · Smaller file".
56	* S2 — the same pinned to `{"preset_id":"h264"}`: the Speed popup is drawn
57	  disabled. "Drawn enabled / disabled": the layout dump carries no enabled
58	  flag, so the popup's darkest pixel is compared with the Format popup's in

64	  `video_bitrate`: HEVC's 0.07 bits per pixel per frame) and R2 at the

71	the copy's own for a core mutant, `hevc_alpha_proof.own_core`) with each of the
72	mutant's anchors replaced (each found exactly once), builds its app
73	(`tree_copy.build_app`), runs every row but R on it (and, for a core mutant,
74	its `cargo test` file in the copy's core), and exits 1 when exactly the named
75	rows fail (caught), 0 when none of them does (survived), 3 when they fail
76	with others beside them, and 2 when the control could not be performed (a
77	copy, an anchor, a build or a launch).

81	  brand-unpatched            the finished file is never branded: A2
82	  all-sync                   every sample marked sync: A5

89	  colour-untagged-container  the format description's colour extensions
90	                             dropped: A3b

92	An instrument that cannot run is a FAIL, never an exit.

229	def trace(path):
230	    """`trace_headers` over the video: (header fields before the first packet,
231	    [{"key": bool, "fields": [(name, value)]}] per packet)."""
232	    ran = run(["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-v", "trace", "-i", path, "-map", "0:v:0", "-c",
233	               "copy", "-bsf:v", "trace_headers", "-f", "null", "-"])
234	    head, out = [], []
235	    for line in ran["stderr"].splitlines():
236	        if "[trace_headers" not in line or "] " not in line:
237	            continue
238	        body = line.split("] ", 1)[1]
239	        started = re.match(r"Packet: \d+ bytes, (key frame, )?pts", body)
240	        if started:
241	            out.append({"key": bool(started.group(1)), "fields": []})
242	            continue
243	        field = re.match(r"\d+\s+(\S+)\s+[01]+ = (-?\d+)$", body.strip())
244	        if field:
245	            (out[-1]["fields"] if out else head).append((field.group(1), int(field.group(2))))
246	    return head, out

250	    """Whether a packet's shown frame is a KEY_FRAME: a frame header with

271	def boxes(data, start, end):
272	    at = start
273	    while at + 8 <= end:
274	        size, kind = struct.unpack(">I4s", data[at:at + 8])
275	        header = 8
276	        if size == 1:
277	            size, header = struct.unpack(">Q", data[at + 8:at + 16])[0], 16
278	        elif size == 0:
279	            size = end - at
280	        if size < header or at + size > end:
281	            return
282	        yield kind.decode("latin-1"), at + header, at + size
283	        at += size

286	def colr_of(path):
287	    """The `av01` sample entry's `colr` box: (type, primaries, transfer, matrix,
288	    full_range) or None, read from the file's bytes."""
289	    data = Path(path).read_bytes()
290	
291	    def find(start, end, chain):
292	        for kind, body, stop in boxes(data, start, end):
293	            if kind != chain[0]:
294	                continue
295	            if len(chain) == 1:
296	                return body, stop
297	            if kind == "stsd":
298	                body += 8            # version, flags, entry count
299	            found = find(body, stop, chain[1:])
300	            if found:
301	                return found
302	        return None
303	
304	    for _, trak, trak_end in [b for b in boxes(data, 0, len(data)) if b[0] == "moov"]:
305	        for kind, body, stop in boxes(data, trak, trak_end):
306	            if kind != "trak":
307	                continue
308	            entry = find(body, stop, ["mdia", "minf", "stbl", "stsd", "av01"])
309	            if not entry:
310	                continue
311	            # VisualSampleEntry: 6 reserved + 2 index + 16 pre_defined/reserved + 4 size
312	            # + 8 resolution + 4 reserved + 2 frame count + 32 compressor + 2 depth + 2 -1.
313	            for child, cbody, cstop in boxes(data, entry[0] + 78, entry[1]):
314	                if child == "colr" and data[cbody:cbody + 4] == b"nclx":
315	                    p, t, m = struct.unpack(">HHH", data[cbody + 4:cbody + 10])
316	                    return ("nclx", p, t, m, data[cbody + 10] >> 7)
317	            return None
318	    return None

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Road map "codec-export" C1 — the `av1` row: AV1 in MP4 through the bundled
SVT-AV1 (spec §11 CX-1, CX-2, CX-9, CX-10, CX-12).

    python3 tools/proof/av1_export_proof.py [--app debug|release|PATH] [--rate]
    python3 tools/proof/av1_export_proof.py --mutant NAME

Launches its own instances of the chosen app (`proof_app.py`: `--app`, else
`RC_PROOF_APP`, else Debug; a build older than its inputs is refused) on scratch
sockets, works under `tools/proof/work/av1-export/`, closes every project it opens
with `discard: true` and stops each instance by its own PID. ffprobe and ffmpeg
(Homebrew, with libdav1d) only READ the files: this Mac has no AV1 decoder, so
nothing here imports or plays an AV1 file through Frame Job or AVFoundation.

Rows (`<ID> ok|FAIL — <detail>`, then `scores: n/m`; exit 0 iff all passed):

* Z1 — every instance's log is silent: no `Frame Job: ` line (the parity check),
  no `Svt[` line (SVT's own banner, which CX-12 (6) routes away) and no
  `SVT-AV1: ` line (a warning or error it passed on).
* A1 — `export {preset: av1}` of AV.mov (640 × 360, 30 fps, 5 s) under a text

def check(ident, ok, detail):

# ---- reading the files (ffprobe, ffmpeg, the MP4's bytes) ------------------------

def run(argv, seconds=600):
    return bounded.run([str(a) for a in argv], seconds)


def streams(path):
    ran = run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_entries",
               "stream=codec_type,codec_name,codec_tag_string,profile,pix_fmt,width,height,"
               "duration,bit_rate,nb_frames,time_base", "-of", "json", path])
    return json.loads(ran["stdout"] or "{}").get("streams", [])


def video_stream(path):
    return next((s for s in streams(path) if s.get("codec_type") == "video"), {})


def brands(path):
    ran = run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_entries", "format_tags=compatible_brands",
               "-of", "json", path])
    return (json.loads(ran["stdout"] or "{}").get("format", {}).get("tags", {})
            .get("compatible_brands", ""))


def decoded_frames(path):
    ran = run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-count_frames", "-select_streams", "v:0",
               "-show_entries", "stream=nb_read_frames", "-of", "csv=p=0", path])
    try:
        return int(ran["stdout"].strip().split(",")[0])
    except ValueError:
        return None


def decode_errors(path):
    ran = run(["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-v", "error", "-i", path, "-f", "null", "-"])
    return ran["rc"], [line for line in ran["stderr"].splitlines() if line.strip()]


def packets(path):
    """ffprobe's video packets: [(pts seconds, key)]."""
    ran = run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-select_streams", "v:0", "-show_entries",
               "packet=pts_time,flags", "-of", "csv=p=0", path])
    out = []
    for line in ran["stdout"].splitlines():
        parts = line.strip().split(",")
        if len(parts) >= 2 and parts[0] not in ("", "N/A"):
            out.append((float(parts[0]), "K" in parts[1]))
    return out


def trace(path):
    """`trace_headers` over the video: (header fields before the first packet,
    [{"key": bool, "fields": [(name, value)]}] per packet)."""
    ran = run(["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-v", "trace", "-i", path, "-map", "0:v:0", "-c",
               "copy", "-bsf:v", "trace_headers", "-f", "null", "-"])
    head, out = [], []
    for line in ran["stderr"].splitlines():
        if "[trace_headers" not in line or "] " not in line:
            continue
        body = line.split("] ", 1)[1]
        started = re.match(r"Packet: \d+ bytes, (key frame, )?pts", body)
        if started:
            out.append({"key": bool(started.group(1)), "fields": []})
            continue
        field = re.match(r"\d+\s+(\S+)\s+[01]+ = (-?\d+)$", body.strip())
        if field:
            (out[-1]["fields"] if out else head).append((field.group(1), int(field.group(2))))
    return head, out


def shows_key(fields):
    """Whether a packet's shown frame is a KEY_FRAME: a frame header with
    `frame_type` 0 and `show_frame` 1."""
    frame_type = None
    for name, value in fields:
        if name == "show_existing_frame":
            frame_type = None
        elif name == "frame_type":
            frame_type = value
        elif name == "show_frame" and value == 1 and frame_type == 0:
            return True
    return False


def y_plane(path, width, height, index=0):
    ran = subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-v", "error", "-i", str(path), "-vf",
                          f"select=eq(n\\,{index})", "-frames:v", "1", "-f", "rawvideo",
                          "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-"], capture_output=True, timeout=120)
    data = ran.stdout
    return data[:width * height] if len(data) >= width * height else None


def boxes(data, start, end):
    at = start
    while at + 8 <= end:
        size, kind = struct.unpack(">I4s", data[at:at + 8])
        header = 8
        if size == 1:
            size, header = struct.unpack(">Q", data[at + 8:at + 16])[0], 16
        elif size == 0:
            size = end - at
        if size < header or at + size > end:
            return
        yield kind.decode("latin-1"), at + header, at + size
        at += size


def colr_of(path):
    """The `av01` sample entry's `colr` box: (type, primaries, transfer, matrix,
    full_range) or None, read from the file's bytes."""
    data = Path(path).read_bytes()

    def find(start, end, chain):
        for kind, body, stop in boxes(data, start, end):
            if kind != chain[0]:
                continue
            if len(chain) == 1:
                return body, stop
            if kind == "stsd":
                body += 8            # version, flags, entry count
            found = find(body, stop, chain[1:])
            if found:
                return found
        return None

    for _, trak, trak_end in [b for b in boxes(data, 0, len(data)) if b[0] == "moov"]:
        for kind, body, stop in boxes(data, trak, trak_end):
            if kind != "trak":
                continue
            entry = find(body, stop, ["mdia", "minf", "stbl", "stsd", "av01"])
            if not entry:
                continue
            # VisualSampleEntry: 6 reserved + 2 index + 16 pre_defined/reserved + 4 size
            # + 8 resolution + 4 reserved + 2 frame count + 32 compressor + 2 depth + 2 -1.
            for child, cbody, cstop in boxes(data, entry[0] + 78, entry[1]):
                if child == "colr" and data[cbody:cbody + 4] == b"nclx":
                    p, t, m = struct.unpack(">HHH", data[cbody + 4:cbody + 10])
                    return ("nclx", p, t, m, data[cbody + 10] >> 7)
            return None
    return None


# ---- the instance ----------------------------------------------------------------

class Instance:
    def __init__(self, label, app, arguments=(), env=None, home=False):
        self.label = label
        self.dir = WORK / label
        tree_copy.remove_tree(str(self.dir))
        self.dir.mkdir(parents=True)
        self.log = self.dir / "instance.log"
        if home:
            (self.dir / "home").mkdir()
            env = {**(env or {}), "CFFIXED_USER_HOME": str(self.dir / "home")}
        self.launched = mcp.launch(str(proof_app.executable(app)), list(arguments),
                                   env=bounded.child_env(env or {}), log_path=str(self.log),
                                   timeout=900)
        self.client = self.launched.client

    def stop(self):
        self.launched.stop()
        mcp.remove_scratch(self.launched.socket_path)

    def complaints(self):
        try:
            lines = self.log.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines()
        except OSError:
            return ["the log could not be read"]
        return [line.strip() for line in lines
                if "Frame Job: " in line or "Svt[" in line or "SVT-AV1: " in line]


class Doc:
    def __init__(self, instance, name, width=640, height=360):
        self.client = instance.client
        self.path = str(instance.dir / f"{name}.framejob")
        self.client.call("new_project", path=self.path)
        try:
            self.call("set_canvas", width=width, height=height, fps=30)
        except mcp.ToolError as error:
            if "made no change" not in str(error):    # a new project is 1920 × 1080 at 30
                raise

    def call(self, tool, **arguments):
        return self.client.call_with(tool, {"project": self.path, **arguments})

    def track(self):
        return self.call("get_project")["project"]["tracks"][0]["id"]

    def media(self, path):
        return self.call("import_media", path=str(path))["media"]

    def close(self):
        try:
            self.call("close_project", discard=True)
        except mcp.ToolError:
            pass


def av_doc(instance, name):
    """AV.mov from 0 under a two-second text clip on a track of its own."""
    doc = Doc(instance, name)
    media = doc.media(AV)
    doc.call("add_clip", track=doc.track(), media=media, at=0)
    doc.call("add_track", name="Titles")
    titles = doc.call("get_project")["project"]["tracks"][-1]["id"]
    doc.call("add_text_clip", track=titles, at=0, duration=2 * SEC, text={"content": "AV1"})
    return doc


def export(doc, path, **arguments):
    Path(path).unlink(missing_ok=True)
    return doc.client.export_with({"project": doc.path, "path": str(path), **arguments})


def refusal(doc, path, **arguments):
    Path(path).unlink(missing_ok=True)
    try:
        answer = doc.client.call_with("export", {"project": doc.path, "path": str(path),
                                                 **arguments})
    except mcp.ToolError as error:
        return str(error)
    if isinstance(answer, dict) and "export_id" in answer:
        try:
            doc.client.wait_export(answer["export_id"], seconds=300)
        except mcp.ToolError:
            pass
    return None

def rows_a1_a5(doc, out):
    a1 = out / "a1.mp4"
    try:
        done = export(doc, a1, preset="av1")
    except mcp.ToolError as error:
        for ident in ("A1", "A2", "A3a", "A3b", "A4", "A5"):
            check(ident, False, f"A1's export failed: {error}")
        return
    got = streams(a1)
    video = next((s for s in got if s.get("codec_type") == "video"), {})
    audio = next((s for s in got if s.get("codec_type") == "audio"), {})
    seen = (video.get("codec_name"), video.get("codec_tag_string"), video.get("profile"),
            video.get("pix_fmt"), video.get("width"), video.get("height"),
            audio.get("codec_name"), audio.get("codec_tag_string"))
    want = ("av1", "av01", "Main", "yuv420p", 640, 360, "aac", "mp4a")
    length = float(video.get("duration") or 0)
    check("A1", done.get("status") == "done" and seen == want and abs(length - 5) <= 1 / 30,
          f"status {done.get('status')}, {done.get('bytes')} bytes; read {seen} (want {want}); "
          f"video {length:.3f} s")
    found = brands(a1)
    check("A2", "av01" in found, f"compatible brands {found!r}")

    head, per_packet = trace(a1)
    every = head + [f for p in per_packet for f in p["fields"]]
    names = ("color_description_present_flag", "color_primaries", "transfer_characteristics",
             "matrix_coefficients", "color_range")
    values = {n: sorted({v for k, v in every if k == n}) for n in names}
    check("A3a", values == {names[0]: [1], names[1]: [1], names[2]: [1], names[3]: [1],
                            names[4]: [0]},
          f"the sequence headers' {values}")
    colr = colr_of(a1)
    check("A3b", colr == ("nclx", 1, 1, 1, 0), f"the av01 entry's colr {colr}")

    rc, errors = decode_errors(a1)
    count = decoded_frames(a1)
    tds = [v for k, v in every if k == "obu_type" and v == 2]
    check("A4", rc == 0 and not errors and count == FRAMES and not tds,
          f"ffmpeg rc {rc}, {len(errors)} error lines {errors[:2]}; {count} frames decoded "
          f"(want {FRAMES}); {len(tds)} temporal delimiters in {len(per_packet)} packets")

    listed = packets(a1)
    keys = [t for t, k in listed if k]
    gaps = [b - a for a, b in zip(keys, keys[1:])] + ([length - keys[-1]] if keys else [])
    bound = math.ceil(length / 2) + 1
    mismatched = [i for i, p in enumerate(per_packet) if p["key"] != shows_key(p["fields"])]
    ok = (len(listed) == len(per_packet) and listed and listed[0][1] and gaps
          and max(gaps) <= 2.0 + 1e-6 and len(keys) <= bound and len(keys) < len(listed)
          and not mismatched)
    check("A5", ok, f"{len(listed)} packets ({len(per_packet)} traced), keys at {keys}; "
          f"longest K-to-K gap {max(gaps) if gaps else None} s (≤ 2.0); {len(keys)} keys "
          f"(≤ {bound}), {len(listed) - len(keys)} not; K flag ≠ shown KEY_FRAME at "
          f"{mismatched[:6]}")


def row_a6(instance, out):
    path = out / "a6.mp4"
    path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    detail = ""
    ok = False
    doc = None
    try:
        doc = Doc(instance, "a6", 1920, 1080)
        media = doc.media(AV)
        track = doc.track()
        for k in range(24):
            doc.call("add_clip", track=track, media=media, at=k * 5 * SEC)
        clips = [c["id"] for c in doc.call("get_project")["project"]["clips"]]
        doc.call("set_video", clips=clips, patch={"scale": 3.0})
        length = doc.call("get_project")["project"]
        started = doc.client.call_with("export", {"project": doc.path, "path": str(path),
                                                  "preset": "av1", "encoder_speed": "balanced"})
        job = started["export_id"]
        # The export measures its sound first (the "Measuring loudness…" phase, whose
        # progress is the bar's first share, and the bar is put at that share's end when
        # the writer starts); the cancel must land while SVT-AV1 encodes, so it waits for
        # the phase to end and then for the bar to move past where the writer started it.
        progress, status, measured, floor = 0, {}, None, None
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 300
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            status = doc.client.call("export_status", export_id=job)
            progress = status.get("progress") or 0
            if status.get("status") in ("done", "failed", "cancelled"):
                break
            if status.get("phase"):
                measured = max(measured or 0, progress)
            elif status.get("status") == "running" and measured is not None:
                if floor is None:
                    floor = progress
                elif progress > floor:
                    break
            time.sleep(0.05)
        if status.get("status") != "running":
            detail = f"never running past the measurement with progress above it: {status}"
        else:
            asked = time.monotonic()
            doc.client.call("cancel_export", export_id=job)
            final = {}
            while time.monotonic() - asked < 600:
                final = doc.client.call("export_status", export_id=job)
                if final.get("status") in ("done", "failed", "cancelled"):
                    break
                time.sleep(0.05)
            took = time.monotonic() - asked
            exists = path.exists()
            ok = final.get("status") == "cancelled" and took <= CANCEL_BOUND and not exists
            detail = (f"cancelled while encoding, at progress {progress:.4f} (the measurement "
                      f"ended at {measured}, the writer started at {floor}); status {final.get('status')!r} "
                      f"{took:.2f} s after cancel_export (≤ {CANCEL_BOUND}); a file at the "
                      f"path: {exists}; the project {len(clips)} clips, "
                      f"{length['canvas']['width']} × {length['canvas']['height']}")
    except (mcp.ToolError, KeyError) as error:
        detail = f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"
    finally:
        if doc is not None:
            doc.close()
    check("A6", ok, detail)


def row_a7(doc, out, a1_bytes):
    sizes, lines, ok = {}, [], True
    for speed in ("faster", "balanced", "smaller"):
        path = out / f"a7-{speed}.mp4"
        started = time.monotonic()
        try:
            done = export(doc, path, preset="av1", encoder_speed=speed)
        except mcp.ToolError as error:
            ok = False
            lines.append(f"{speed}: {error}")
            continue
        sizes[speed] = done.get("bytes")
        good = done.get("status") == "done" and done.get("encoder_speed") == speed
        ok = ok and good
        lines.append(f"{speed}: {done.get('status')}, echoed {done.get('encoder_speed')!r}, "
                     f"{done.get('bytes')} bytes, {time.monotonic() - started:.1f} s")
    # Pairwise more than 1 % apart: SVT-AV1's threads make two encodes of one
    # project at one speed differ by a few bytes (A1 against A7's balanced, printed),
    # so "different" alone would pass with the speed ignored.
    values = [v or 0 for v in sizes.values()]
    distinct = len(values) == 3 and all(
        abs(a - b) > 0.01 * max(a, b) for i, a in enumerate(values) for b in values[i + 1:])
    noise = (abs(sizes["balanced"] - a1_bytes) if a1_bytes and sizes.get("balanced")
             else None)
    bad = refusal(doc, out / "a7-fast.mp4", preset="av1", encoder_speed="fast")
    other = refusal(doc, out / "a7-h264.mp4", preset="h264", encoder_speed="faster")
    left = [p.name for p in (out / "a7-fast.mp4", out / "a7-h264.mp4") if p.exists()]
    refused = (bad is not None and "encoder_speed" in bad and other is not None
               and "encoder_speed" in other and not left)
    check("A7", ok and distinct and refused,
          "; ".join(lines) + f"; sizes pairwise more than 1 % apart {distinct} (A1's balanced "
          f"encode of the same project differs from this one by {noise} bytes); "
          f"\"fast\" → {bad!r}; "
          f"h264 → {other!r}; files left {left}")


def row_a8(doc, out):
    box = out / "a8-box.mp4"
    hd = out / "a8-720p.mp4"
    detail, ok = "", False
    try:
        export(doc, box, preset="av1", size=[640, 480])
        export(doc, hd, preset="av1", size="720p")
        video = video_stream(box)
        plane = y_plane(box, 640, 480)
        top = max(plane[:640 * 56]) if plane else None
        middle = (sum(plane[640 * 200:640 * 280]) / (640 * 80)) if plane else None
        wide = video_stream(hd)
        rc, errors = decode_errors(hd)
        ok = ((video.get("width"), video.get("height")) == (640, 480) and top is not None
              and top <= 20 and middle > 20
              and (wide.get("width"), wide.get("height")) == (1280, 720) and rc == 0
              and not errors)
        detail = (f"[640, 480]: {video.get('width')} × {video.get('height')}, the top 56 rows' "
                  f"highest luma {top} (≤ 20), the middle rows' mean "
                  f"{middle if middle is None else round(middle, 1)} (> 20); 720p: "
                  f"{wide.get('width')} × {wide.get('height')}, decode rc {rc} {errors[:2]}")
    except mcp.ToolError as error:
        detail = str(error)
    check("A8", ok, detail)


def row_a9(doc, out):
    path = out / "a9.mp4"
    try:
        doc.call("set_range", start=1 * SEC, end=3 * SEC)
        export(doc, path, preset="av1", range="in_out")
        count = decoded_frames(path)
        check("A9", count == 60, f"{count} frames decoded from the 1 s – 3 s export (want 60)")
    except mcp.ToolError as error:
        check("A9", False, str(error))


def run_a_rows(app, logs):
    out = WORK / "out"
    tree_copy.remove_tree(str(out))
    out.mkdir(parents=True)
    instance = Instance("a", app)
    logs.append(instance)
    try:
        if instance.client is None:
            for ident in ("A1", "A2", "A3a", "A3b", "A4", "A5", "A6", "A7", "A8", "A9"):
                check(ident, False, f"the app did not listen ({instance.log})")
            return
        try:
            doc = av_doc(instance, "a1")
        except (mcp.ToolError, KeyError, IndexError) as error:
            for ident in ("A1", "A2", "A3a", "A3b", "A4", "A5", "A7", "A8", "A9"):
                check(ident, False, f"A1's project could not be made: {error}")
            doc = None
        try:
            if doc is not None:
                rows_a1_a5(doc, out)
                a1 = out / "a1.mp4"
                row_a7(doc, out, a1.stat().st_size if a1.exists() else None)
                row_a8(doc, out)
                row_a9(doc, out)
        finally:
            if doc is not None:
                doc.close()
        row_a6(instance, out)
    finally:
        instance.stop()


# ---- the sheet -------------------------------------------------------------------

def popup_darkest(png, views, scale, popup):
    """The darkest luma inside `popup`'s frame in the capture, through ffmpeg."""
    ran = subprocess.run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_entries", "stream=width,height",
                          "-of", "csv=p=0", str(png)], capture_output=True, text=True)
    width, height = (int(x) for x in ran.stdout.strip().split(",")[:2])
    raw = subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-v", "error", "-i", str(png), "-f", "rawvideo",
                          "-pix_fmt", "gray", "-"], capture_output=True).stdout
    x0, y0, w, h = (round(c * scale) for c in popup["frame"])
    pixels = [raw[y * width + x] for y in range(max(0, y0), min(height, y0 + h))
              for x in range(max(0, x0), min(width, x0 + w))]
    return min(pixels) if pixels else None


def sheet_reading(app, label, choice):
    """One pinned instance: File ▸ Export… on a project, the sheet read and cancelled."""
    from screens import PINS
    arguments = ["-RCDevAppearance", "light"]
    for key, value in PINS:
        arguments += [f"-{key}", f"<string>{choice}</string>"
                      if key == "FrameJobExportChoice" else value]
    instance = Instance(label, app, arguments, home=True)
    reading = {"instance": instance}
    try:
        if instance.client is None:
            reading["error"] = "the app did not listen"
            return reading
        doc = av_doc(instance, "sheet")
        png = instance.dir / "sheet.png"
        try:
            doc.call("perform_menu_item", path=["File", "Export…"])
            try:
                got = doc.call("snapshot_ui", window="sheet", path=str(png))
            finally:
                doc.call("cancel_sheet")
            dump = json.loads(Path(got["layout_path"]).read_text())
        finally:
            doc.close()
        views = [v for v in dump.get("views", []) if not v.get("hidden")]
        scale = dump.get("scale", 2)

        def popup_after(label_text):
            at = next((v["i"] for v in views if v.get("text") == label_text), None)
            return next((v for v in views if at is not None and v["i"] > at
                         and v.get("class") == "NSPopUpButton"), None)

        speed, fmt = popup_after("Speed:"), popup_after("Format:")
        reading.update({
            "format": fmt and fmt.get("text"), "speed": speed and speed.get("text"),
            "footnote": [v["text"] for v in views
                         if v.get("text") and v.get("tooltip") == v["text"]],
            "speed_dark": speed and popup_darkest(png, views, scale, speed),
            "format_dark": fmt and popup_darkest(png, views, scale, fmt)})
    except (mcp.ToolError, OSError, ValueError, KeyError) as error:
        reading["error"] = f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"
    finally:
        instance.stop()
    return reading


def run_s_rows(app, logs):
    one = sheet_reading(app, "s1", '{"preset_id":"av1","encoder_speed":"smaller"}')
    two = sheet_reading(app, "s2", '{"preset_id":"h264"}')
    logs += [one["instance"], two["instance"]]

    def drawn(reading):
        if reading.get("speed_dark") is None or reading.get("format_dark") is None:
            return None
        lighter = reading["speed_dark"] - reading["format_dark"]
        return "enabled" if lighter <= 40 else "disabled" if lighter > 60 else "unclear"

    check("S1", not one.get("error") and one.get("format") == "AV1 (MP4)"
          and one.get("speed") == "Smaller file" and drawn(one) == "enabled"
          and one.get("footnote") == ["AV1 · MP4 · Smaller file"],
          f"{one.get('error') or ''} format {one.get('format')!r}, Speed {one.get('speed')!r} "
          f"drawn {drawn(one)} (darkest {one.get('speed_dark')} against Format's "
          f"{one.get('format_dark')}), footnote {one.get('footnote')}")
    check("S2", not two.get("error") and two.get("format") == "H.264 (MP4)"
          and drawn(two) == "disabled",
          f"{two.get('error') or ''} format {two.get('format')!r}, Speed {two.get('speed')!r} "
          f"drawn {drawn(two)} (darkest {two.get('speed_dark')} against Format's "
          f"{two.get('format_dark')}), footnote {two.get('footnote')}")


# ---- the rate (CX-9 (4)) ---------------------------------------------------------

def run_r_rows(app, logs):
    if not OWNER.exists():
        for ident in ("R1", "R2"):
            print(f"{ident} skipped — the owner's fixture {OWNER} is not here", flush=True)
        return
    out = WORK / "rate"
    tree_copy.remove_tree(str(out))
    out.mkdir(parents=True)
    instance = Instance("r", app)
    logs.append(instance)
    pixels = 1920 * 1080 * 30
    tiers = {"R1": (None, round(pixels * 0.07)),
             "R2": (max(100_000, round(pixels * 0.129 * 0.6 / 100_000) * 100_000), None)}
    try:
        if instance.client is None:
            for ident in tiers:
                check(ident, False, "the app did not listen")
            return
        doc = Doc(instance, "rate", 1920, 1080)
        try:
            media = doc.media(OWNER)
            doc.call("add_clip", track=doc.track(), media=media, at=0)
            for ident, (asked, default) in tiers.items():
                target = asked or default
                lines, ok = [], True
                for n in range(3):
                    path = out / f"{ident}-{n}.mp4"
                    arguments = {"preset": "av1", "encoder_speed": "balanced"}
                    if asked:
                        arguments["video_bitrate"] = asked
                    started = time.monotonic()
                    try:
                        done = export(doc, path, **arguments)
                    except mcp.ToolError as error:
                        ok = False
                        lines.append(f"run {n + 1}: {error}")
                        continue
                    took = time.monotonic() - started
                    video = video_stream(path)
                    rate = int(video.get("bit_rate") or 0)
                    frames = int(video.get("nb_frames") or 0)
                    lines.append(f"run {n + 1}: {rate} b/s ({rate / target:.3f} of the target), "
                                 f"{frames} frames in {took:.1f} s = {frames / took:.1f} fps")
                check(ident, ok, f"target {target} b/s "
                      f"({'video_bitrate ' + str(asked) if asked else 'Format default'}); "
                      + "; ".join(lines))
        finally:
            doc.close()
    finally:
        instance.stop()


# ---- the mutants -----------------------------------------------------------------

def build_mutant(name):
    """The copy with the anchors replaced, built: (app, copy) or (None, why)."""
    dest = WORK / "mutant"
    made, reason = tree_copy.make_copy(str(dest))
    atexit.register(tree_copy.remove_tree, str(dest))
    if made is None:
        return None, reason
    copy = Path(made)
    anchors = MUTANTS[name]["anchors"]
    if any(path.startswith("core/") for path, _, _ in anchors):
        from hevc_alpha_proof import own_core
        reason = own_core(copy)
        if reason:
            return None, reason
        try:
            (copy / "core/tests").symlink_to(ROOT / "core/tests")
        except OSError as error:
            return None, f"the copy's core/tests could not be linked: {error}"
    for path, anchor, replacement in anchors:
        target = copy / path
        if not target.resolve().is_relative_to(dest.resolve()):
            return None, f"{path} in the copy is the tree's own file"
        text = target.read_text()
        if text.count(anchor) != 1:
            return None, f"the anchor occurs {text.count(anchor)} times in {path}: {anchor!r}"
        target.write_text(text.replace(anchor, replacement))
    app, reason = tree_copy.build_app(copy, 1800)
    return (app, copy) if app else (None, reason)


def run_mutant(name):
    if name not in MUTANTS:
        print(f"unknown mutant {name}; the mutants are {sorted(MUTANTS)}")
        return 2
    named = MUTANTS[name]["rows"]
    print(f"mutant {name}: building the copy", flush=True)
    app, copy = build_mutant(name)
    if app is None:
        print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — {copy}")
        return 2
    failed_tests = []
    cargo = MUTANTS[name].get("cargo")
    if cargo:
        ran = bounded.run(["cargo", "test", "--release", "--no-fail-fast", "--test", cargo],
                          1200, cwd=str(copy / "core"))
        out = ran["stdout"] + ran["stderr"]
        if ran["expired"] or "test result:" not in out:
            print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — cargo rc {ran['rc']}: "
                  f"{out[-600:]}")
            return 2
        failed_tests = re.findall(r"^test (\w+) \.\.\. FAILED$", out, re.M)
        check(f"cargo-{cargo}", ran["rc"] == 0, f"failed tests {failed_tests}")
        named = named + [f"cargo-{cargo}"]
    logs = []
    try:
        run_rows(app, logs)
    except Exception as error:  # an instrument that cannot run is the control's failure
        print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — {error}")
        return 2
    failing = sorted(k for k, v in results.items() if not v)
    print(f"mutant {name}: named {sorted(named)}, failing {failing}")
    if sorted(named) == failing:
        print(f"MUTANT CAUGHT: {name}")
        return 1
    if not set(named) & set(failing):
        print(f"MUTANT SURVIVED: {name}")
        return 0
    print(f"MUTANT CAUGHT, NOT EXACTLY: {name}")
    return 3


# ---- main ------------------------------------------------------------------------

def run_rows(app, logs, rate=False):
    run_a_rows(app, logs)
    run_s_rows(app, logs)
    if rate:
        run_r_rows(app, logs)
    found = [(i.label, line) for i in logs for line in i.complaints()]
    check("Z1", not found, f"{len(logs)} instance logs; complaints {found[:4]}")


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="the av1 row (codec-export C1)")
    parser.add_argument("--app", help="debug, release or a .app path (default RC_PROOF_APP)")
    parser.add_argument("--rate", action="store_true", help="also R1 and R2 (CX-9 (4))")
    parser.add_argument("--mutant", help="one of " + ", ".join(MUTANTS))
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if args.app:
        os.environ[proof_app.ENV] = args.app
    WORK.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if args.mutant:
        return run_mutant(args.mutant)
    logs = []
    try:
        app = proof_app.bundle()
        proof_app.require_fresh(proof_app.executable(app))
    except (proof_app.StaleApp, ValueError, OSError) as error:
        check("A0", False, f"the app cannot be driven: {error}")
        print("scores: 0/1")
        return 1
    print(f"app {app}", flush=True)
    run_rows(app, logs, rate=args.rate)
    passed = sum(results.values())
    print(f"scores: {passed}/{len(results)}")
    return 0 if all(results.values()) else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

content.content:
padding tail and `canvasPerDest`; captions as text clips and the cue rules; the popups rule; undo
grouping and the "do not flush" trap; the `async` and `Synchronization` confinement; the
`DispatchQueue` seams; tracking areas; `offMainTools`; `target(_:)`; `rawPatchArg` and the
lenient-decoding rule.

## Decisions

### Core edge

- **`ReelOp` lives with its factories in `ReelOps.swift`. Only `ReelOp.coreNames()` stays in
  `ReelCore.swift`.** A change like adding `scope` edits the struct and its factories together.
  `coreNames()` calls `rc_*`, and only `ReelCore.swift` may do that. `OpArgs` stayed `private`
  because it moved along with every user it has (orig file map, `ReelCore` · `ReelOps`).
- **Any addition to `ReelCore.swift` pays for itself first with a pure move of a type that names
  no `rc_*` symbol.** The precedents are `RecipeSource.swift`, `TextPatch.swift` and
  `MediaDescriptor.swift`. The file is far over the cap (orig "ReelCore.swift toll", "graphics
  wrappers").

### Motion (E2)

- **The core, not the app, turns a motion preset into placement.** The inspector and the canvas
  therefore see the clip without its motion, so a canvas drag begun mid-motion starts from the
  base box (orig `MotionProps` row).
- **A Zoom to Region armed over a clip with a During motion shows a second hint pill.** The zoom
  is solved without the motion. `regionNote` is re-read in `syncRegionMode` because a stored value
  went stale while the mode stayed armed (orig "Three Motion files", N·3).
- **The Motion menu's None is exactly `motionNoneTag` (−1).** A tag that no builder writes answers
  nothing. The old check `tag < 0` let a tag of −7 clear a clip's arrival (N·1).
- **The timeline's During glyph reads `dotLeft`, the position the label-dot branch decided.** It
  no longer infers it from `nameEnd`. This moves no pixel, and only its mutant fails (N·2).
- **Motion's Preview sets the in/out range to the clip and turns Loop on, and both stay set

char *rc_hdr10_still_peak(const uint8_t *file, size_t file_len);

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------- av1 */

/* An AV1 encoder's container bytes, decided in the core (spec 11 CX-12 (4));
 * the encoder itself is the app's (CX-4) and nothing here encodes.
 *
 * rc_av1_config: the `av1C` record (AV1-ISOBMFF 2.3) for `obus`, an OBU run
 * holding a sequence header OBU (type 1; the first one is used), parsed per
 * AV1 5.5 through color_config. JSON {"av1c_hex": the record as lowercase
 * hex, "seq_profile", "seq_level_idx" (operating point 0's), "seq_tier",
 * "bit_depth", "monochrome", "color": {"primaries", "transfer", "matrix",
 * "full_range"}} (2/2/2 when the header describes no colour). The record is
 * 0x81, profile << 5 | level, tier << 7 | high_bitdepth << 6 | twelve_bit
 * << 5 | monochrome << 4 | subsampling_x << 3 | subsampling_y << 2 |
 * chroma_sample_position, 0x00, then the sequence header OBU with its size
 * field. NULL with a message through `err_out` when there is no sequence
 * header or it ends early (naming the byte or the bit and the field), or on
 * a caught panic. Freed with rc_string_free. */
char *rc_av1_config(const uint8_t *obus, size_t len, char **err_out);

/* Removes every temporal delimiter OBU (type 2) from the AV1 packet in
 * `bytes`, in place, and answers the length kept (AV1-ISOBMFF 2.4: a sample
 * carries none). 0 for a NULL pointer, a 0 length, a run that is not
 * well-formed OBUs each with a size field (the bytes untouched), or a
 * caught panic. */
size_t rc_av1_strip_temporal_delimiters(uint8_t *bytes, size_t len);

/* Makes the `ftyp` box at the start of `head` (a written MP4's first
 * bytes) carry `av01` (AV1-ISOBMFF 2.1): 0 when it is already a compatible
 * brand, 1 when the first `mp41` compatible brand was rewritten `av01` in
 * place, -1 when there is no `ftyp` box at byte 0, it runs past `len`, or
 * it has neither (the bytes untouched), or on a caught panic. */
int32_t rc_av1_ftyp_brand(uint8_t *head, size_t len);

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------- agent */

/* C signature of the host tool handler. Called from the server thread for
 * every `tools/call`. Must return a CallToolResult JSON object allocated
 * with `rc_agent_string_create` (ownership passes back across the return),
 * or NULL for handler failure. */
typedef char *(*RcAgentToolHandler)(void *context, const char *tool_name,
                                    const char *arguments_json);

/* Allocates a NUL-terminated copy of `s` owned by this library, for tool
 * handlers to return. Never freed by the caller. */
char *rc_agent_string_create(const char *s);

/* Binds the embedded MCP server's Unix-socket listener at `socket_path`,
 * chmod 0600. `tools_json` is the `tools/list` catalog as a JSON array.
 * True, or false with a message through `err_out`.
 * One per process: a second start is an error ("agent socket already
 * bound"). Never unlinks an existing file. */
bool rc_agent_socket_start(const char *socket_path, const char *server_name,
                           const char *server_version, const char *tools_json,
                           RcAgentToolHandler handler, void *context, char **err_out);

/* For quit. Takes the listener out of its slot and unlinks the socket file
 * only if it is still the one this listener bound (same device and inode),
 * then abandons the listener: its thread is neither unblocked nor joined, so
 * a call in flight cannot hold the quit, and process exit ends it. `handler`
 * and `context` must stay valid for the life of the process. Safe when none
 * is bound. */
void rc_agent_socket_release(void);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif /* FRAMEJOB_CORE_H */

content.content:
and default rate (the `hevc` prefix). ffprobe reports `hevc`, `Main 10`,
`yuv420p10le` and an `mp42` major brand (`precision_proof.py` T1), and the
precision road map's 10-bit ramp comes through it at less than half the
error it shows through `hevc` (T2; the figures are in
`designs/adr/precision.md`).

**AV1 (codec-export C1, §11 CX-1, CX-2, CX-9, CX-10, CX-12).** One row after
`hevc_10bit`: `av1`, "AV1 (MP4)", MP4 with AAC, 8-bit 4:2:0, even-sized, no
alpha. Its picture is encoded by the bundled SVT-AV1 (CX-4), not
VideoToolbox, and the row says so in a field of its own, `writer`
(`"svt_av1"`); `avf_preset` is `AVAssetExportPresetPassthrough`, a record
only, because AVFoundation still writes the container, so the row is routed
and sized as every AVFoundation row is and `avf_preset: null` keeps meaning
ImageIO. `rc_export_presets` gives the row alone `writer` and
`encoder_speeds` (`["faster", "balanced", "smaller"]`), and its resolved
settings alone end with `writer` and `encoder_speed` — the override
(`faster`, `balanced`, `smaller`: SVT-AV1's presets 8, 6 and 4, CX-2),
`balanced` when absent; a word that is not one of the three is refused on
any row (`export encoder_speed must be "faster", "balanced" or "smaller",
not …`) and a speed on any other row is refused naming it (`{id} has no
encoder speed; encoder_speed applies to av1`). Every other row's settings
are the text they were. The frames: the reader's 64RGBAHalf frames are
scaled on the GPU (`MPSImageLanczosScale`) when the export size is not the
canvas — fitted with black bars, or filling a frame within a pixel of the
canvas's shape, G-33 (c) — and converted by `ExportI420.metal` to BT.709
video-range I420 (Y = round(16 + 219·Y′), chroma the mean of each 2 × 2
block, premultiplied RGB as it is, so a transparent canvas lands on black);
a serial encode queue owns the encoder (`ExportEncodePump`), with progress
counted by frames submitted, the cancel flag read before each read, send
and append, and the end of stream drained before `markAsFinished`. SVT-AV1
runs single-pass VBR at `video_bitrate`, or at HEVC's 0.07 bits per pixel
per frame when none is asked (CX-9), with a closed GOP and a keyframe at
least every 2 s (`intra_period_length` = ⌊2·fps⌋ − 1), and writes BT.709
primaries, transfer and matrix in video range into its sequence header. The
container bytes are the core's (`rc_av1_*`, CX-12 (4)): the `av1C` record
built from SVT's sequence header OBU, each packet's temporal delimiters
stripped, and the finished file's `ftyp` rewritten in place so `av01` is a
compatible brand (`isom mp41 mp42` → `isom av01 mp42`); a file whose `ftyp`
cannot take it fails the export. The packets go to a passthrough
`AVAssetWriterInput` whose format description holds the `av1C` and the BT.709
colour tags (the `colr` box), one sample each, a key picture a sync sample.
SVT's own log goes through its callback: warnings and errors as `SVT-AV1: …`
lines in the system log, nothing else. **On an M1 or M2 Mac Frame Job cannot
play or re-import its own AV1 file, and QuickTime cannot either (CX-10):**
those Macs have no AV1 decoder, and #216's refusal stands.

**Depth (§11 PR-1, PR-3).** The export reader reads the compositor's own
format, `64RGBAHalf` (`Compositor.outputPixelFormat`), and each row decides
what its encoder is handed (`ExportWriter.frameForm`, `ExportFrames` in
`ExportStraightAlphaHalf.swift`): `prores_422` and `prores_4444` take the
16-bit frames as they are (10-bit 4:2:2 and 12-bit 4:4:4:4 files), and so
24:| **Speed** | How long the AV1 encoder works on each frame. See [Speed](#speed). | Balanced |
35:- **Footnote:** the codec, the container (left out when it is the same word, as in `GIF`), the AV1 speed (`AV1 · MP4 · Balanced`), the video rate, the audio rate (`192 kbps audio`), the loudness target (`−14 LUFS`) and `alpha` when the format keeps transparency. When you pick a Quality tier and the format sets its own rate, it reads `format's own rate` instead of a number.
47:| AV1 (MP4) | `.mp4` | The smallest delivery file, encoded by the AV1 encoder built into Frame Job. 8-bit. Slower to export than HEVC. See [Speed](#speed). |
56:Sound in the movie formats is stereo at 48 kHz: AAC in H.264, HEVC, HEVC with Alpha and AV1, and 16-bit LPCM in both ProRes formats. GIF and APNG carry no sound. A file's sound is exactly as long as the range it exports, including when a clip in it plays faster or slower.
73:- **Even dimensions.** H.264, HEVC, HEVC with Alpha, HEVC 10-bit, AV1 and ProRes 422 need them, so an odd width or height is written one pixel smaller. ProRes 4444, GIF and APNG keep an odd edge.
80:### Speed
82:The **Speed** row sits under Format (under Dynamic Range in an HDR project). It is live only on **AV1 (MP4)**; on every other format it is greyed out and keeps your last choice.
86:| **Faster** | The quickest AV1 export, a slightly larger file for the same picture. |
88:| **Smaller file** | The slowest AV1 export, the smallest file for the same picture. |
90:AV1 is encoded in software, so it takes longer than the HEVC formats, which use the Mac's hardware encoder. The choice is remembered with the rest of the sheet and stored in presets.
111:- HEVC formats and AV1 ask for 60 % of the H.264 rate. AV1's **Format default** is the HEVC rate too.
250:Only HEVC 10-bit, ProRes 422 and ProRes 4444 can carry HDR. On every other video format, AV1 included, the row is greyed out on **SDR version**, which is what those formats write. What each choice contains, and how the SDR version is made, is in [HDR and colour](hdr-and-color.md#exporting-hdr).
267:- **Speed ramps and Keep pitch off.** An export waits for the rendered audio of every speed ramp, and of every clip at a constant speed other than ×1 with Keep pitch off, to finish before it writes, and shows "Preparing…" meanwhile. That sound is never exported silent (see [Speed](speed.md)). If it cannot be rendered, the export fails with "Clip *n*'s retimed audio could not be rendered: …".
278:| `preset` (required) | Format | `h264`, `hevc`, `hevc_alpha`, `hevc_10bit`, `av1`, `prores_422`, `prores_4444`, `audio_m4a`, `audio_wav`, `audio_aiff`, `gif`, `apng`. |
287:| `encoder_speed` | Speed | `faster`, `balanced` (default) or `smaller`. `av1` only; refused on every other format. |
295:  - `done` adds `bytes`, the settings the file was written with, `burn_in_timecode`, `dynamic_range` in an HLG project, `encoder_speed` for AV1, any `graphic_warnings` and, for every format with sound, `loudness`: `summary`, `integrated_lufs`, `true_peak_dbtp`, `sample_peak_dbfs`, `gain_db`, `ceiling_dbtp`, `capped_by_peak` and `target_lufs`.
311:- On an M1 or M2 Mac Frame Job cannot play or re-import its own AV1 file; QuickTime cannot either. Those Macs have no AV1 decoder.
312:- AV1 is 8-bit only. A bit rate asked of AV1 is a target, and the file often comes in under it.

content.content:
### Quality

**Format default** lets the encoder choose the video rate. The sound uses 192 kbps AAC.

The four tiers set a video rate from the frame's size, so a tier means the same picture quality at every size. Each tier's title shows the rate it would ask for at the size and frame rate now chosen.

| Tier | Video at 1080p, 30 fps or less (H.264) | AAC sound |
|---|---|---|
| **Low** | 4.0 Mbps | 128 kbps |
| **Medium** | 6.0 Mbps | 192 kbps |
| **High** | 8.0 Mbps | 256 kbps |
| **Maximum** | 12.0 Mbps | 320 kbps |

- The video rate scales with the frame's area. High is about 3.6 Mbps at 720p and 32 Mbps at 4K.
- Above 30 fps, the video rate is 1.5 times higher.
- HEVC formats and AV1 ask for 60 % of the H.264 rate. AV1's **Format default** is the HEVC rate too.
- Audio only (M4A) uses the tier's AAC rate alone.
- Quality is greyed out for ProRes, WAV, AIFF, GIF and APNG, where the format fixes the rate.

### Loudness

Loudness normalises the whole mix to an integrated loudness target, measured to ITU-R BS.1770-4.

| Choice | Target |
|---|---|
| **Off** | No normalisation. The export still measures its sound and reports it. |
| **−14 LUFS (streaming)** | Where the main streaming services normalise. |
| **−16 LUFS** | The usual target for stereo podcasts. |
| **−23 LUFS (broadcast)** | EBU R 128 broadcast delivery. |
| **Custom…** | Type any target from −70 to 0 LUFS, to one decimal place. |

    return False

          f"longest K-to-K gap {max(gaps) if gaps else None} s (≤ 2.0); {len(keys)} keys "
          f"(≤ {bound}), {len(listed) - len(keys)} not; K flag ≠ shown KEY_FRAME at "
          f"{mismatched[:6]}; hidden intra frames at {hidden[:6]}")'''
assert t.count(old) == 1
t = t.replace(old, new)
old = '''  KEY_FRAME (`frame_type` 0 with `show_frame` 1) and no other packet's is.

  asks the three speeds' sizes to be more than 1 % apart rather than merely different;
  `speed-ignored`'s three files were within 0.5 % of each other.

- Root `CLAUDE.md` file map: `app/Resources/Shaders/` holds `ExportI420.metal` beside

**Owed.** SE-17 (an M3 or later plays the `av1` export in QuickTime and Frame Job re-imports
it, picture and sound in sync) is the owner's. C2–C6 above; #376's acknowledgements, a
`published_check.py` row for the codecs and an Actions cache for `build/codecs` (from C0).

`export` takes `preset` and `path`, plus `size`, `range` (`project` or
`in_out`), `video_bitrate`, `audio_bitrate`, `loudness_lufs`, `peak_dbtp`,

`hevc_alpha`, `hevc_10bit`, `av1`, `prores_422`, `prores_4444`, `audio_m4a`,
`audio_wav`, `audio_aiff`, `gif` and `apng`. There is no frame-rate
argument: an export runs at the project's rate, or at 12.5 fps for `gif` and
25 fps for `apng`. An existing file at the path is replaced, and the
format's extension is added when the path has none. `peak_dbtp` without
`loudness_lufs` is refused. `dynamic_range` `hlg` or `pq` is refused outside
`hevc_10bit`, `prores_422` and `prores_4444`, and in an SDR project.
`encoder_speed` (`faster`, `balanced` or `smaller`) is `av1`'s alone and is
refused on every other preset; the done answer names it. What
each option means is in [Export](export.md).

waits: always `export_id`, `status` (`queued`, `running`, `done`, `failed`

or running job (a running one may still read `running` until the writer
stops) and leaves a finished one alone, answering as `export_status` does.

cd /Users/kevingalligan/devel/framejob-codecs && cat >> designs/spec/11-decisions/codec-export.md <<'EOF'

- **CX-13 — AV1's rate is a ceiling: capped constant quality** (owner, 2026-10-27, "Capped
  constant quality", chosen after C1 measured single-pass VBR at 0.667–0.670 of its target on
  a 55 s 1080p clip; amends CX-9 (1) and (4) for the AV1 rows, CX-9 (2) and (3) standing):
  1. **The mode.** SVT-AV1 runs capped CRF: `rate_control_mode` 0 with `aq_mode` 2 (what its
     own `--crf` sets), `qp` the CRF, and `max_bit_rate` the cap — the mode SVT-AV1 v4.2.0's
     `EbSvtAv1Enc.h` documents for `max_bit_rate` and `mbr_over_shoot_pct` ("Capped CRF") and
     its `enc_settings.c` refuses outside rate-control mode 0. `mbr_over_shoot_pct` stays at
     SVT's 50: the cap is a sliding-window budget that may overshoot by half inside a window
     before SVT raises the quantizer harder, and the whole file's average is held to the cap.
  2. **The cap** is the rate the row resolves today: `video_bitrate` when asked (the Quality
     popup's tier rate, HEVC's 0.6 factor, CX-9 (2)), else HEVC's 0.07 bits per pixel per
     frame ("Format default"), clamped to SVT's 100,000 kb/s.
  3. **The CRF matches or beats HEVC at HEVC's own rate, so a Quality tier moves it.** The
     encoder sees only the cap, so the CRF is a function of the cap's bits per pixel per frame
     (cap ÷ (width × height × fps)) and the speed: linear between the calibrated points below,
     rounded down (a lower CRF is the better picture), and the end point's CRF beyond either
     end. Each point is the highest CRF, in steps of 2 from 18 to 46, at which SVT-AV1 at that
     preset reached VMAF ≥ HEVC's (VideoToolbox at that rate, as the spike asked it) on every
     one of the spike's three 8-bit 1080p clips (gh5, promo, real8;
     `tools/proof/work/codec-spike/crf.py`, `crf.jsonl`):

     | bits per pixel per frame (the 1080p30 rate) | Faster (8) | Balanced (6) | Smaller file (4) |
     |---|---|---|---|
     | 0.0386 (Low, 2.4 Mb/s) | 40 | 44 | 46 |

EOF

content.content:
failed exactly their rows. `codecs_proof.py` 3/3 on Debug and on Release
(`svt-av1 v4.2.0`, `libvpx v1.17.0 (WebM Project VP9 Encoder v1.17.0)`).

## Codec export C1 — AV1 in MP4 (`av1_export_proof.py` Z1, A1–A9, S1, S2, R1, R2; nine mutants; `export_offset_proof.py` E36, E37; spec §11 CX-12)

The `av1` row: the compositor's frames converted to BT.709 video-range I420 on
the GPU (`ExportI420.metal`), encoded by the bundled SVT-AV1 on a serial encode
queue (`ExportEncodePump`), its packets stripped of temporal delimiters and
written through a passthrough `AVAssetWriterInput` whose `av01` format
description holds the core's `av1C` (`rc_av1_config`), and the finished file's
`ftyp` branded `av01` (`rc_av1_ftyp_brand`).

```
python3 tools/proof/av1_export_proof.py [--app debug|release|PATH]          # Z1, A1–A9, S1, S2
python3 tools/proof/av1_export_proof.py --rate                              # also R1, R2 (CX-9's re-measurement)
python3 tools/proof/av1_export_proof.py --mutant NAME                       # exit 1 caught, 0 survived, 3 inexact, 2 control
python3 tools/proof/export_offset_proof.py <dir>/agent.sock --only E36,E37  # clicks and flashes through av1
```

**`av1_export_proof.py`** launches its own instances (scratch sockets, stopped
by their own PIDs) and works under `work/av1-export/`. ffprobe and ffmpeg
(Homebrew, libdav1d) only read the files: this Mac (an M2) has no AV1 decoder,
so no row imports or plays one through Frame Job. Its docstring has every row;
in short: Z1 the logs carry no `Frame Job: `, `Svt[` or `SVT-AV1: ` line; A1 the
stream kinds (`av1`/`av01`/Main/`yuv420p`/640 × 360, `aac`/`mp4a`); A2 the
`av01` brand; A3a the sequence header's colour (1/1/1, video range); A3b the
`colr` box read from the MP4's bytes (`nclx` 1/1/1, full_range 0); A4 a clean
decode of 150 frames and no temporal delimiter; A5 the keyframes (first K, gap
≤ 2 s, count bound, K flag = shown KEY_FRAME both ways); A6 a 1080p, 120 s
export cancelled within 10 s with no file; A7 the three speeds echoed and
their sizes pairwise more than 1 % apart (two encodes at one speed differ by a
few hundred bytes, so "different" alone would not see a speed ignored), and
`"fast"` and `encoder_speed` on `h264` refused naming the key; A8 a letterboxed
640 × 480 and a 1280 × 720; A9 an in/out export of 60 frames; S1, S2 the
sheet's Speed row on an instance pinned to `av1` at `smaller` and to `h264`
(enabled and disabled read off the popup's darkest pixel against the Format
popup's, the layout dump having no enabled flag). R1, R2 (`--rate`) export the
owner's 55 s 1080p clip three times each at "Format default" and at High and
print the target, the bit rate ffprobe reads and the encode's frames per
second; a missing fixture skips them by name.

The mutants (`--mutant`, a tree copy, `core/` the copy's own for the two core
ones) and their rows: `td-kept` A4 and `cargo test --test av1_mp4`;
`brand-unpatched` A2; `all-sync` A5; `open-gop` A5; `speed-ignored` A7;
`encode-ignores-cancel` A6; `speed-on-any-row` A7 and `cargo test --test
export_av1`; `colour-untagged-bitstream` A3a; `colour-untagged-container` A3b.

**Runs (2026-10-27).** Debug and Release 13/13; `--rate` on Release 15/15 (the
undershoot printed: 0.667–0.670 of the target in all six runs). Seven mutants
were caught exactly; `all-sync` and `open-gop` survive as equivalent mutants (the
passthrough writer takes `av01` sync samples from the bitstream, and SVT-AV1
wrote the same keyframes with a forward-keyframe GOP on the 5 s clip), recorded
in `designs/codec-export.md`'s C1 findings. `encode-ignores-cancel` was caught
only after A6 waited for the loudness measurement to end before cancelling.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Codec export C1 fix pass (spec §11 CX-13): calibrate the `av1` row's CRF on the
owner's IMG_0018.MOV through Frame Job itself, since the spike's command-line
encodes of a decoded file do not transfer to the app's own frames.

crf_owner.py [--reuse]

Builds a Debug copy of the tree (`tree_copy`, in `work/crf-owner-tree/`) whose
`SVTAV1Encoder` takes its CRF from the file `work/crf-owner/crf` when that holds a
number (an instrument only, never in the tree), launches it, makes the owner
clip's 1920 × 1080 30 fps project, exports `prores_422` (the reference, as
`av1_export_proof.py` R does), `hevc` at the five calibration rates, and `av1` at
each speed and CRF 12..30 step 2 with a cap of 50 Mb/s (so the cap never binds),
and scores each against the reference with ffmpeg's libvmaf. Appends to
`crf.jsonl` (`clip` "owner", `via` "app").
"""
import json, os, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path

S = Path("/Users/kevingalligan/devel/framejob-codecs/tools/proof/work/codec-spike")
PROOF = S.parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(PROOF))
import bounded  # noqa: E402
import mcp  # noqa: E402
import proof_app  # noqa: E402
import tree_copy  # noqa: E402

WORK = PROOF / "work" / "crf-owner"
TREE = PROOF / "work" / "crf-owner-tree"
CRF_FILE = WORK / "crf"
OWNER = PROOF / "media" / "owner-sync" / "IMG_0018.MOV"
LOG = S / "crf.jsonl"
RATES = {"low": 2_400_000, "medium": 3_600_000, "default": 4_354_560, "high": 4_800_000,
         "maximum": 7_200_000}
ANCHOR = "        config.qp = Self.crf(speed: speed, bitsPerPixel: Double(cap)\n"
PATCH = ("        config.qp = (try? String(contentsOfFile: \"" + str(CRF_FILE) + "\", encoding: .utf8))"
         ".flatMap { UInt32($0.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)) }"
         " ?? Self.crf(speed: speed, bitsPerPixel: Double(cap)\n")


def build():
    made, reason = tree_copy.make_copy(str(TREE))
    if made is None:
        raise SystemExit(f"copy: {reason}")
    path = TREE / "app/Sources/ExportAV1Encoder.swift"
    text = path.read_text()
    assert text.count(ANCHOR) == 1, "anchor"
    path.write_text(text.replace(ANCHOR, PATCH))
    app, reason = tree_copy.build_app(TREE, 1800)
    if app is None:
        raise SystemExit(f"build: {reason}")
    return app


def vmaf(distorted, reference, tag):
    log = WORK / f"{tag}.vmaf.json"
    lavfi = ("[0:v]format=yuv420p,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS[d];[1:v]format=yuv420p,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS[r];"
             f"[d][r]libvmaf=log_fmt=json:log_path={log}:n_threads=12")
    subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-v", "error", "-i", str(distorted), "-i",
                    str(reference), "-lavfi", lavfi, "-f", "null", "-"], check=True)
    return round(json.loads(log.read_text())["pooled_metrics"]["vmaf"]["mean"], 3)


def rate_of(path):
    ran = subprocess.run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-select_streams", "v:0", "-show_entries",
                          "stream=bit_rate", "-of", "csv=p=0", str(path)],
                         capture_output=True, text=True)
    return int(ran.stdout.strip() or 0)


def record(row):
    with open(LOG, "a") as f:
        f.write(json.dumps(row) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps(row), flush=True)


def main():
    WORK.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    CRF_FILE.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    app = proof_app.bundle(str(TREE)) if "--reuse" in sys.argv else build()
    launched = mcp.launch(str(proof_app.executable(app)), [], env=bounded.child_env({}),
                          log_path=str(WORK / "instance.log"), timeout=900)
    client = launched.client
    project = str(WORK / "owner.framejob")
    call = lambda tool, **a: client.call_with(tool, {"project": project, **a})
    try:
        client.call("new_project", path=project)
        media = call("import_media", path=str(OWNER))["media"]
        call("add_clip", track=call("get_project")["project"]["tracks"][0]["id"], media=media,
             at=0)
        reference = WORK / "reference.mov"
        if not reference.exists():
            client.export_with({"project": project, "path": str(reference),
                                "preset": "prores_422"})
        for tier, bps in RATES.items():
            out = WORK / f"hevc-{tier}.mp4"
            out.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            extra = {} if tier == "default" else {"video_bitrate": bps}
            client.export_with({"project": project, "path": str(out), "preset": "hevc", **extra})
            record({"kind": "hevc", "via": "app", "clip": "owner", "tier": tier,
                    "target_bps": bps, "actual_bps": rate_of(out),
                    "vmaf": vmaf(out, reference, f"hevc-{tier}")})
        for speed, preset in (("faster", 8), ("balanced", 6), ("smaller", 4)):
            for crf in range(12, 31, 2):
                CRF_FILE.write_text(str(crf))
                out = WORK / f"av1-{speed}-{crf}.mp4"
                out.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                started = time.monotonic()
                client.export_with({"project": project, "path": str(out), "preset": "av1",
                                    "encoder_speed": speed, "video_bitrate": 50_000_000})
                record({"kind": "svt", "via": "app", "clip": "owner", "preset": preset,
                        "crf": crf, "cap_bps": None, "tier": None,
                        "wall_s": round(time.monotonic() - started, 1),
                        "actual_bps": rate_of(out), "vmaf": vmaf(out, reference,
                                                                  f"av1-{speed}-{crf}")})
                out.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    finally:
        CRF_FILE.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        try:
            call("close_project", discard=True)
        except mcp.ToolError:
            pass
        launched.stop()
        mcp.remove_scratch(launched.socket_path)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

content.content:
- **CX-13 — AV1's rate is a ceiling: capped constant quality** (owner, 2026-10-27, "Capped
  constant quality", chosen after C1 measured single-pass VBR at 0.667–0.670 of its target on
  a 55 s 1080p clip; amends CX-9 (1) and (4) for the AV1 rows, CX-9 (2) and (3) standing):
  1. **The mode.** SVT-AV1 runs capped CRF: `rate_control_mode` 0 with `aq_mode` 2 (what its
     own `--crf` sets), `qp` the CRF, and `max_bit_rate` the cap — the mode SVT-AV1 v4.2.0's
     `EbSvtAv1Enc.h` documents for `max_bit_rate` and `mbr_over_shoot_pct` ("Capped CRF") and
     its `enc_settings.c` refuses outside rate-control mode 0. `mbr_over_shoot_pct` (how far a
     window may run over the cap before SVT raises the quantizer harder) is 15, not SVT's 50:
     at the calibrated CRFs Faster's gh5 files averaged 1.11–1.20 × the cap at 50 (Medium and
     up), up to 1.03 × at 25 and up to 0.999 × at 20, while at 10 the cap clamped hard enough
     to drop gh5 at Medium 0.02 VMAF under HEVC; at 15 all 45 files (each speed, point and
     clip) averaged at most 0.954 × the cap and reached HEVC's VMAF (the least margin +0.010). **The tolerance:** the whole file's average video
     rate is at or under the cap, none allowed (`av1_export_proof.py` R1, R2).
  2. **The cap** is the rate the row resolves today: `video_bitrate` when asked (the Quality
     popup's tier rate, HEVC's 0.6 factor, CX-9 (2)), else HEVC's 0.07 bits per pixel per
     frame ("Format default"), clamped to SVT's 100,000 kb/s.
  3. **The CRF matches or beats HEVC at HEVC's own rate, so a Quality tier moves it.** The
     encoder sees only the cap, so the CRF is a function of the cap's bits per pixel per frame
     (cap ÷ (width × height × fps)) and the speed: linear between the calibrated points below,
     rounded down (a lower CRF is the better picture), and the end point's CRF beyond either
     end. Each point is the highest CRF, in steps of 2 from 18 to 46, at which SVT-AV1 at that
     preset reached VMAF ≥ HEVC's (VideoToolbox at that rate, as the spike asked it) on every
     one of the spike's three 8-bit 1080p clips (gh5, promo, real8;
     `tools/proof/work/codec-spike/crf.py`, `crf.jsonl`):

     | bits per pixel per frame (the 1080p30 rate) | Faster (8) | Balanced (6) | Smaller file (4) |
     |---|---|---|---|
     | 0.0386 (Low, 2.4 Mb/s) | 40 | 44 | 46 |
     | 0.0579 (Medium, 3.6 Mb/s) | 28 | 34 | 38 |
     | 0.0700 (Format default, 4.35 Mb/s) | 26 | 32 | 34 |
     | 0.0772 (High, 4.8 Mb/s) | 26 | 30 | 30 |
     | 0.1157 (Maximum, 7.2 Mb/s) | 18 | 24 | 24 |

     The binding clip is mostly promo, a near-lossless graphic whose VMAF saturates near 97.7
     (its margins are hundredths of a point); real8 binds Balanced's Maximum and Smaller
     file's top three. On the two camera clips alone each CRF would be 0–12 higher.
  4. **What the user is told.** The guide, the sheet's tier titles and footnote ("up to …")
     and `export`'s `video_bitrate` description say the rate is a ceiling and the file size is
     not known in advance. **Risk accepted:** a file's size is no longer predictable from its
     rate, the calibration is three 5 s clips at 1080p (other sizes are placed by bits per
     pixel alone), and HEVC's VMAF is VideoToolbox's through ffmpeg, as the spike measured it.
